character.morphology: Catalog record 10, generation1, familyBits0. Suspended seed body with paired leaves. No legs or biped/quadruped gait.
character.locomotion: Seed tilts and leaves spread, rise or fold; preserve seed-to-leaf-root relation and diagonal poses09/10.
character.faceAndExpression: Visible face opening differs12/13 and23/24; folded canopy13/21/54/55/58 obscures face. Do not draw open eyes through occluding leaves.
character.appendages: Exactly two leaf surfaces on root above seed; lengths/folds change by source cell. Original feline markings stay on this structure; no added cat limbs/tail.
character.restraint: Main026..042: gold wrap around seed, not around leaf tips; follows tilted/flattened body.
character.specialStates: Main043 red,046/047 black,060 stone,063 white; derive only when exact source alpha/palette relation is proved.
